summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Equinor ASA reporting the outcome of its annual general meeting held on 12 May 2026. The meeting approved the annual report, a cash dividend of USD 0.39 per share for Q4 2025, and routine governance items including the election of corporate assembly members, auditor remuneration, and authorization for share acquisitions under employee incentive plans. No shareholder proposals were adopted. This is a routine meeting report with no special-situations event such as an M&A, activist campaign, restructuring, or delisting.
